subject: Orbit pilot — need to reschedule and include security + procurement
messages:
From: Dana Lewis <dana.lewis@prioryhealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Orbit pilot — demo next week

Hi Vivek,

Quick heads up — a few folks who are critical to the Orbit pilot review just flagged that they need to join the demo next week (security, infra, and procurement). We have a couple of travel conflicts among the gatekeepers as well, so the original 60-minute slot on May 22 won't let us cover both product and the security edge cases.

Two asks from our side: can we either (A) split into a short product walk-through + separate security deep-dive, or (B) move to a single extended 2-hour session so everyone can stay on the same call? Procurement also wants time to ask contractual/PO questions.

I'm copying procurement so they can advise availability. If you have a preferred approach or suggested dates/times, let me know and we'll try to be flexible — most of us are on the road May 23–25.

Thanks,
Dana Lewis
Director, IT Governance — Priory Health
[Attachment: security-questionnaire-priory.xlsx]
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Dana Lewis <dana.lewis@prioryhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 May 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Orbit pilot — demo next week

Dana — thanks for the flag. Totally reasonable to include security/procurement. Two options from our side:

Option 1 (recommended): split into two focused sessions — 45–60m product overview + 45m security deep-dive. Less cognitive load for your reviewers and we can have the right SMEs on each call.

Option 2: single 2-hour session to keep continuity and allow live Q&A across teams.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Product overview: Tue May 24, 11:00–12:00 PT
- Security deep-dive: Wed May 25, 09:00–09:45 PT
OR
- Single session: Thu May 26, 10:00–12:00 PT

I'm looping in Monica and Marissa to help coordinate invites and Karthik/Soojin to lead the technical/security sections. Attached is a short SOW draft for context — gives procurement a baseline.

If you prefer a different set of times, we can adjust. Which option do you prefer?

— Vivek
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOW-priory-draft.pdf]
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 May 2028 10:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Orbit pilot — demo next week

Team — forwarding Priory's ask. They need security + procurement on the call, and some reviewers are traveling May 23–25. Could we confirm who can own the security deep-dive and whether we should lean Option 1 (split sessions) or Option 2 (single extended)?

Quick notes: Karthik, you're listed as SE and lead for product walkthrough. Soojin, would you be available to lead the security session? Monica/Marissa, procurement will want the SOW + billing/PO next steps — see attachment.

Also — we should prep the security questionnaire answers ahead of the deep-dive; I've attached the client's questionnaire from Dana.

Thanks, Vivek
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 May 2028 12:19:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Orbit pilot — demo next week

Vivek — I'm traveling May 24–25 (customer visits) so Option 1 with product on the 24th won't work for me unless I can dial in late. I can do the single 2-hour slot on May 26 and will be available to present then.

Soojin — can you take the security deep-dive if we do Option 1? If not, I think Option 2 (May 26 10–12 PT) is the simplest for alignment.

Monica/Marissa — I'll need the SOW and the security questionnaire answers consolidated before the call; happy to help with slides but won't be here earlier in the week.

— Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Dana Lewis <dana.lewis@prioryhealth.com>, Todd Baker <todd.baker@prioryhealth.com>, procurement@prioryhealth.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 May 2028 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Orbit pilot — demo next week — confirmed slot request

Dana / team — thanks for the flexibility. Based on internal availability and to make sure we have full coverage across product + security + procurement, can we lock Option 2: single 2-hour session? Proposed calendar slot:

Thu, May 26, 2028 — 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM PT (2 hours)

Attendees from Redwood: Vivek (facilitate), Karthik (product walk-through), Soojin (security deep-dive), Monica & Marissa (commercial/procurement).

Action items for Priory before the session:
- Confirm procurement attendee who will handle contractual questions (we were copied Todd — is he the PO contact?),
- Share any high-priority checklist items from the attached security questionnaire so Soojin can prep targeted answers,
- If you prefer split sessions after all, say so and we'll revert to Option 1.

I'll send a calendar invite once you confirm the attendee list. Attached: SOW draft + client's security questionnaire (we've redacted nothing here — it's for prep).

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
[Attachments: SOW-priory-draft.pdf, security-questionnaire-priory.xlsx]
